page.overview:
Who is Kathulos?

Kathulos of the Eternal Lives, the Living Planet ---- Kathulos the Slave-Seer

Kathulos was a fictional character by Marvel Comics and first appeared in Marvel Premiere #8 (May, 1973), written by Gardner Fox and Jim Starlin. Kathulos was also named Kulthas.

Both names were created by Robert E. Howard: The Atlantean sorcerer Kathulos (: "Skull-Face") and the evil deity Kulthas (: "The Curse of the Golden Skull"). Kulthas was invoked in Marvel Comics' Conan stories.

"L'mur-Kathulos" was also listed along with various eldritch entities and locations (: "The Whisperer in Darkness")
